rules.title: Instruction to Report on Algorithm-Based Rent Setting Ban
rules.requirement: The City Council instructed the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of entities using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on its use.
rules.quoted_span: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City.
